source_assessment: One commit changes two documentation files, six review/evidence files and one test file. No taxon records, causal overlays, page renderer, schema, export, style or workflow source changed.

search.rationale: Fresh browser behavior and the independently inspected documentation/review/test-only diff preserve the prior judgment. Independent identifier, label and unmatched queries were executed; their live counts and result rows are retained.

facets.rationale: Fresh browser behavior and the independently inspected documentation/review/test-only diff preserve the prior judgment. Property-filter selection, combination with search and reset were independently exercised.

result_counts.rationale: Fresh browser behavior and the independently inspected documentation/review/test-only diff preserve the prior judgment. Observed counts respond to queries and facets and are distinct from the total.

sorting.rationale: Fresh browser behavior and the independently inspected documentation/review/test-only diff preserve the prior judgment. Each available sort option was selected, with URL/control state and first result rows retained.

shareable_state.rationale: Fresh browser behavior and the independently inspected documentation/review/test-only diff preserve the prior judgment. Combined BACTERIA/SPECIES/NCBITAXON with query NCBITaxon:562 gives 239; reload preserves only query/sort, clears all three facets and returns 259.

full_catalogue.rationale: Fresh browser behavior and the independently inspected documentation/review/test-only diff preserve the prior judgment. The total is backed by linked listings/category pagination or complete indexed corpus; search-result caps are assessed separately.

record_pages.rationale: Fresh browser behavior and the independently inspected documentation/review/test-only diff preserve the prior judgment. Multiple stable individual record URLs opened successfully from a fresh browser navigation.

term_links.rationale: Fresh browser behavior and the independently inspected documentation/review/test-only diff preserve the prior judgment. The sampled own-grounding and main-section terms have readable labels beside resolver anchors.

evidence.rationale: Fresh browser behavior and the independently inspected documentation/review/test-only diff preserve the prior judgment. Sampled record references include working-format PMID/DOI/source URL anchors rather than only database navigation.

review_status.rationale: Fresh browser behavior and the independently inspected documentation/review/test-only diff preserve the prior judgment. Sampled record headers explicitly state their workflow state.

curation_history.rationale: Fresh browser behavior and the independently inspected documentation/review/test-only diff preserve the prior judgment. Sampled records show dated curation-event sections with attribution and action text.

source_link.rationale: Fresh browser behavior and the independently inspected documentation/review/test-only diff preserve the prior judgment. Sampled record pages link their own YAML source file rather than just the repository root.

domain_view.rationale: Fresh browser behavior and the independently inspected documentation/review/test-only diff preserve the prior judgment. Domain figures or maps rendered in the independently opened routes, with data-bearing visuals.

cross_mech_links.rationale: Fresh browser behavior and the independently inspected documentation/review/test-only diff preserve the prior judgment. Strain/source identifiers referring to kg-microbe are plain text; suite navigation does not count as a record cross-link.

corpus_stats.rationale: Fresh browser behavior and the independently inspected documentation/review/test-only diff preserve the prior judgment. The generated landing figures were read from the browser and compared with the audited corpus counts.

category_browse.rationale: Fresh browser behavior and the independently inspected documentation/review/test-only diff preserve the prior judgment. Landing links lead into distinct category subsets with continuation where needed.

suite_nav.rationale: Fresh browser behavior and the independently inspected documentation/review/test-only diff preserve the prior judgment. Visible suite-directory links occur in the reviewed navigation or footer.

downloads.rationale: Fresh browser behavior and the independently inspected documentation/review/test-only diff preserve the prior judgment. The bulk search-index gzip contains listing metadata, while complete details are fetched separately per record.

schema_docs.rationale: Fresh browser behavior and the independently inspected documentation/review/test-only diff preserve the prior judgment. Visible schema links reach raw LinkML YAML; consistent fleet arbitration requires partial when rendered schema documentation is not provided.

license.rationale: Fresh browser behavior and the independently inspected documentation/review/test-only diff preserve the prior judgment. Reviewed landing, browser, records and maps distinguish CC BY data from BSD code.

build_provenance.rationale: Fresh browser behavior and the independently inspected documentation/review/test-only diff preserve the prior judgment. The site exposes the corpus digest and upstream releases without a dated site or own-record version.

theme_toggle.rationale: Fresh browser behavior and the independently inspected documentation/review/test-only diff preserve the prior judgment. Dark was selected and independently carried across the valid reviewed routes.

responsive.rationale: Fresh browser behavior and the independently inspected documentation/review/test-only diff preserve the prior judgment. Every valid reviewed route was checked at fresh and resized 390px; none exceeded the viewport.

load_failure.rationale: Fresh browser behavior and the independently inspected documentation/review/test-only diff preserve the prior judgment. Relevant data requests were aborted and the resulting reader-facing error was inspected.
